card.text: A cold giant planet, wider than the white dwarf it circles every 34 hours.

introduction.text: WD 1856+534 b is nearly Jupiter's size and about eight times wider than its star. JWST saw its own faint heat, about 186 K.

shape.title: Shape only
shape.summary: A sphere of the measured radius. Gray marks the unknown visible colour; the light is its white dwarf's.
